target_definition.description: Within 180 days: new WAZ crossing below -2 OR WAZ decline >= 0.50
target_definition.exclusion: Index observation verified_waz < -2 excluded from primary early-risk cohort

model_selection_basis: Highest PR-AUC on held-out validation set (Stage 7). Final classical vs sequence comparison frozen in Stage 9.
threshold_policy: Frozen from Stage 7 experiment. Not optimized post-test.
selection_rationale: Strongest held-out PR-AUC among all compared models (0.2375 vs 0.1892 Transformer)
Substantially better Brier score (0.0408 vs 0.1705 Transformer)
Strongest precision and specificity: fewer false alarms
Simpler, faster inference pipeline with no sequence construction required
Classical gradient boosting performs robustly on engineered temporal features with this dataset size
warnings: Test set was evaluated exactly once after model selection was frozen.
This model is a research output and has not been externally or clinically validated.
Risk probability is not a clinical diagnosis.
